name: Goat Simulator 3: Buck to the Future Pack
summary:
Step into the hooves of G, a mercenary with horns for hire and a totally made-up character for the sake of this text. Mix and match different futuristic gears for ceaseless body goatification.
The future is now, in the present. Don’t ask how.

Buck to the Future contains 22 new gears (8 with abilities), 6 new instincts, and 1 new playable goat.

- RoboCock
- Hacker Visor
- Stasis Helmet
- Future Fashionista
- Raver
- Synthetic Hair
- Tension Reliever 3K
- Splatien Launcher
- Polygonal Sleeves
- Hi-tech Outfit
- Un-Gravity Boots
- Circuitry Suit
- Circuitry Heels
- Neon Sneakers
- Wormhole Horns
- Pilbot
- E-Wings
- Techwear Backpack
- Main Dish
- Hologoat
- Holohorns
- Dyed (RoboCock Fur)
